modules.name: core
modules.description: General-purpose core combinators. Prelude-owned Option and Result types are available without importing this module.

modules.name: math
modules.description: Numeric helpers including abs, min, max, clamp, pow, factorial, gcd, and sqrt.

modules.name: list
modules.description: Functional array/list combinators including map, filter, fold, append, reverse, and sort.

modules.name: string
modules.description: String helpers including trim, split, join, replace, case conversion, and search.

modules.name: map
modules.description: Persistent map helpers implemented in Nulang over array-backed key/value records.

modules.name: set
modules.description: Persistent set helpers implemented in Nulang over arrays.

modules.name: result
modules.description: Operations on the prelude-owned Result type.

modules.name: option
modules.description: Operations on the prelude-owned Option type.

modules.name: http
modules.description: Higher-level HTTP client wrappers over the built-in Http effect.

modules.name: fs
modules.description: Higher-level filesystem wrappers over the built-in FS effect.

modules.name: json
modules.description: JSON parsing, serialization, and field accessors.
